decisions.reason: Active and relevant, but full-stack and copyleft; V7 already has an HTTP sidecar adapter, so V8 adds only an immutable forward registry and does not vendor/import the project.
Useful discrete-event/latency concepts but archived and calibrated to NASDAQ-style markets with old dependencies; V8 observed-book simulator is smaller and Binance-specific.
Specialized roles/debate/logging are useful, but existing V7 council already provides a smaller compatible pattern.
Potential sentiment benchmark after a labeled validation sample exists; no incremental value has been demonstrated yet.
Existing fold/trial infrastructure already covers the needed workflow; wholesale migration would add dependency and methodology risk.
